name: broad-market-context-coverage-2026-10-23
hypothesis: Audit whether three compact causal SPY context fields can be added to the existing111/26 source without changing raw episodes or reading retired outcomes. Coverage is not a predictive or performance result.

definitions.market_volatility_20: population standard deviation of the20 completed SPY close-to-close log returns
definitions.relative_market_return_20: own20-session split-continuous price log return minus SPY20-session price log return
definitions.dividends: Excluded from these price features; execution cash-dividend accounting unchanged

alignment: Exact same21 session dates in own and SPY windows; every contributing available_time<=decision bar available_time; no stale fill or future window; reject known missing-session crossings
coverage: Use only cached Yahoo snapshot2010-01-04 through2023-12-29 and existing source train/development rows; require source/raw bar identity, audited calendars and explicit missing-session metadata. Inspect every source row without ranking realized returns.
normalization: No fitting/refit or dataset generation in this audit; preserve original seven feature preprocessing. Later candidate requires separately preregistered training-only new-field normalization and matched same-dimension masks.
next: Only complete source/alignment/causality acceptance permits a separate immutable dataset and fixed matched full/masked/legacy-control training protocol. No automatic training allocation or closed-family retuning.
limitations: Revised Yahoo bars and retrospective survivors remain; recorded bar availability is an assumption, not verified historical vendor publication. Broad-market context differs from old high-dimensional sector proxies but benefit is unproven.
